embedded_ecc: DISABLED_TEST_MODE_ASSUMPTION; documented in irradiation papers, public entry procedure not recovered
write_policy: correctable single-bit latch only; commit corrected full 39-bit word; clean latch no write
count: one correctable latch whose correcting write completed; includes seven parity positions; release once per complete pass
initial: all encoded words verified clean once before t=0; ECC itself and controller assumed fault-free
application: retained 4 MiB immutable buffer; application reads do not repair and do not feed the count; no application writes during H
event_ties: commit, atomic upset group, latch, completed-pass observation
time_domain: [0,H); event at H excluded; scheduled commit/pass completion at H included
incomplete_pass: committed corrections/resources retained; no completed count; no synthetic zero observation
reference: instantaneous word read/repair at nominal commit epoch
deployment_model: latch at end of 100ns read; 100ns decode and 100ns write; commit delay 200ns; empirical until delay-specific coupling is proved
timing_status: declared controller budgets, not measured WCET or board qualification
